title: Refit a 2U server's air shroud: tuck both front tabs under the fan-wall lip and seat it between the heatsinks
instruction: Seat the 2U server's air shroud flat in the motherboard bay with both front tabs engaged in the fan-wall slots, without touching the processor heatsinks or memory modules with the grippers, and let go.
context: The hard part: the 418 mm air shroud (170 mm long with its two 10 mm front tabs) enters the 165.5 mm motherboard bay nose-down first so both front tabs tuck into the slots under the fan wall's 83 mm top lip, and only then lowers flat between two 78 mm LGA4677 processor heatsinks (2.5 mm clearance per side) and four DDR5 RDIMM banks; lowering it flat first catches the tabs on the lip or lands the rear floor on the 52 mm bay divider, leaving the roof proud. Both hands pinch the recessed 26 mm blue touchpoint bridges inside the shroud's 78 mm 2U height envelope, pitch it together about 17 degrees nose-down to slide both tabs at least 5 mm under the lip, and hinge the rear down cleanly without yawing into the heatsink fins or touching the heatsinks or memory modules with a gripper. Data-center technicians servicing 2U AI and compute nodes remove and refit this baffle before memory, processor, heatsink, or riser work so fan airflow cannot bypass the heatsinks.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x forward, y left, z above the bench; bay heights h are measured above the bay floor (3.0 mm above the bench). Clamped to the bench across x = 12.5..52.5, y = -21.5..+21.5 is an open-top EIA-310-D 2U server-bay fixture (43.0 x 40.0 x 8.81 cm outer, 42.4 cm inner width, cut from 3.0 mm grey ABS sheet per parts.py's cut-list, reproducing the motherboard and fan bay of an SSI-EEB 2U server such as Inter-Tech 2U-2129-N without its front drive cage). Its front closed staging deck spans x = 12.8..30.45 at h = 0.8 cm, bounded at x = 30.45..30.75 by a 5.2 cm mid-bay divider. The 16.55 cm motherboard bay (x = 30.75..47.30) holds two passive LGA4677 2U heatsinks (Dynatron S2, Inter-Tech art. 88885621, 11.8 x 7.8 x 6.4 cm, 526.6 g, silver aluminium on 0.8 cm spacers at x = 39.15, y = +9.5 and -9.5, tops at h = 7.2 cm) and four 4-card banks of JEDEC MO-329 DDR5 RDIMM blanks (Kingston KF560R32RB-16 envelope, 13.335 x 3.125 x 0.38 cm green cards in 0.7 cm white socket rails at x = 39.15, inner banks |y| = 1.6..4.3 cm and outer banks |y| = 15.8..18.5 cm, tops at h = 3.825 cm). At x = 47.30..47.60 stands the 8.3 cm slotted fan bulkhead (1.1 cm top keeper hood x = 47.30..48.40 at h = 7.8..8.3 cm; two white-trimmed 2.2 x 0.75 cm slots at y = +9.5 and -9.5, h = 7.05..7.80 cm), backed by five unpowered 8.0 x 8.0 x 3.8 cm black server fans (ARCTIC S8038-7K, SKU ACFAN00288A, 146 g) in x = 48.4..52.2. A one-piece 3.0 mm black ABS air shroud (41.8 x 16.0 x 7.8 cm, 532 g, two 8.3 cm inner-width CPU ducts, two recessed 2.6 cm blue touchpoint bridges at y = +17.28 and -17.28 flush with the 7.8 cm roof, two white 1.0 x 1.6 x 0.3 cm front tabs at y = +9.5 and -9.5, z = 7.2..7.5 cm) starts right-way-up on yellow deck marks at x = 21.0, y = 0.0 (within 2 mm and 2 degrees), tabs pointing +x. Fixed layout across seeds.
scoring: 0 for good if at any step any part of either gripper touches either processor heatsink or any DDR5 memory module, or if the shroud falls outside the 43.0 x 40.0 cm 2U bay footprint (both whole-trial rules judged from the trial video on the bench, the final photo confirming the end state). Otherwise read at the end of the trial. A front tab is engaged when its tip projects at least 5.0 mm past the x = 47.30 cm bulkhead front face inside its 22.0 x 7.5 mm slot beneath the 78.0 mm slot roof (tab centre within 5.0 mm laterally of y = +95.0 or -95.0 mm). 1.0: both front tabs are engaged at least 5.0 mm in their respective left and right fan-wall slots; all four outer roof corners of the shroud stand at 78.0 +/- 1.5 mm above the bay floor (3.5 to 6.5 mm recessed below the 83.0 mm fan-wall lip); every part of both hands is at least 30 mm clear of the shroud, heatsinks, and memory banks; held so for 1.0 s (20 steps) with the shroud moving 2.0 mm at most. 0.5: both front tabs are engaged at least 5.0 mm in their respective fan-wall slots beneath the lip, while the shroud is not yet seated flat on all four corners or hands are not yet clear. 0 otherwise (including a flat drop onto the 83.0 mm lip or 52.0 mm divider, or a single engaged tab). On the bench: four-corner roof height above the bay floor and tab insertion depth past the bulkhead face with a 150 mm steel rule / depth gauge; gripper-free clearance, 1.0 s stillness, and whole-trial no-touch / no-drop rules from the trial video.
reset_notes: Between trials, about 15 seconds (no consumables): lift the rear of the shroud about 17 degrees nose-down, draw it -x out of the two fan-wall slots, and set it right-way-up on the four yellow corner ticks on the front staging deck (centre x = 21.0 cm, y = 0.0 cm, tabs pointing +x), within 2 mm of the ticks and square within 2 degrees; verify with a glance that none of the 16 RDIMM cards or two bolted heatsinks shifted.
fidelity: 240 Hz PhysX rigid bodies at 20 Hz control with 0.6 mm contact offset on bay and shroud so the 2.50 mm heatsink-to-duct clearance and 7.5 mm slot height act as true geometric constraints. Zero welds, proximity latches, or scripted pushes. The unpowered bay is fixed (clamped); the 532 g ABS shroud is one free compound body of 39 non-overlapping 3.0 mm plates (friction 0.35, blue touchpoint bridges 1.2/1.0). ABS flex and airflow are not modeled.
